N1.text: In India, when a doctor says, arrange blood, families start calling blood banks. One by one.

N2.text: Jeevan Dhara lets them simply ask. In their own language.

N3.text: No forms. No language menu. It asks only for what is missing, and listens again.

N4.text: Gnani's Prisma model turns speech into text, and detects the language by itself.

N5.text: It becomes structured data, checked in code, so a blood group is never guessed. Then the search widens, ring by ring.

N6.text: Gnani's Timbre voice answers, in the same language.

N7.text: Kannada. Tamil. Ten languages. Speech to text in about a second. Search, in one millisecond.

N8.text: Jeevan Dhara. Speak, and find blood. Built on Gnani Prisma and Timbre.

hi_2.text: ओ नेगेटिव, दो यूनिट, जयनगर बेंगलुरु में।

kn_1.text: ನನಗೆ ಬಿ ಪಾಸಿಟಿವ್ ರಕ್ತ ಬೇಕು, ಎರಡು ಯೂನಿಟ್, ಕೋರಮಂಗಲ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು.

ta_1.text: எனக்கு ஏ பாசிட்டிவ் ரத்தம் வேண்டும், டி நகர் சென்னை.
